items.summary: Invesco (NYSE:IVZ) introduced the Invesco Nasdaq International Innovators 100 ETF, ticker QQI, expanding its QQQ Innovation Suite beyond U.S. stocks. The new QQI fund applies a rules based methodology to track a basket of companies focused on innovation outside the United States. The ETF targets investors seeking geographic diversification and access to non U.S. innovation themes through a single exchange traded product. The launch of QQI reshapes how Invesco approaches global innovation...
